items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'll take it. Take Matthew. I'll take you by and then do you, Mr. Matt.

ctx.x: Oh, what? Don't take no picture here. Well, all right.
I'll take it. Take Matthew. I'll take you by and then do you, Mr. Matt.
Well, I mean, you don't look bad at all. You're not looking bad at all. No, you don't look bad. I mean, if it's a bus picture, you don't have to show it.
